body: Weird one, the JS spews some apparently escaped HTML into the DOM. I think it must be a recent regression. Maybe worth a bisect.

The bug is caused by we wrote `{{$.section.GetComputedInlineDiffFor $line}}` ( Add warning for BIDI characters in page renders and in diffs (#17562) ) Before, `GetComputedInlineDiffFor` returns HTML text. Now, `GetComputedInlineDiffFor` returns `DiffInline` struct, so we should change the forgotten `{{$.section.GetComputedInlineDiffFor $line}}` call to output the `DiffInline.Content`. Possible code: https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/d7c2a2951c6a0a85f43675c83d3d639cd50eccb4/templates/repo/diff/blob_excerpt.tmpl#L71

agh this is due to an interaction between the BIDI pr and the diff PR.

When the diff PR was created the BIDI PR wasn't merged and when the BIDI PR was created the diff PR wasn't merged.
Actually no it's a bit of debugging code that got left in.
